resources.string: Pictures you make will be kept here.
Image generation needs a model. Download one from the list or add your own file.
Upscaling needs an upscaler model. It is small: download one from the list.
Describe the picture in English: subject, setting, style, lighting.
Low values keep the source almost as it is; high values keep only its composition.
One-step models always start from scratch and ignore the source. Use a Turbo, LCM or regular model here.
The whole picture is enlarged block by block. Sources too big for a %1$d-megapixel result are reduced first.
Time and memory grow with the area. Models draw best at the size they were trained on, usually 512.
Regular models: around 7. Turbo and LCM models: 1 to 2, higher values burn the picture.
Leave empty for a new random picture every time.
Applied when the model is next loaded. More threads than fast cores slows things down.
Turning the result into a picture…
This takes minutes on a phone. Keep the app open; the screen stays on.
The current step cannot be interrupted; it stops as soon as that step is done.
A single-file Stable Diffusion checkpoint: SD 1.x, SD 2.x, SDXL and their turbo or LCM variants.
ESRGAN-type models that enlarge a picture 4 times.
Replaces the last, memory-hungry stage with a tiny network: faster and lighter, slightly softer. For SD 1.x and 2.x models only.
Replaces the VAE built into the model. Needed only if the model\'s page says so.
Small add-ons that change style or subject. They must match the model family.
This link points to a whole repository. Open the file on Hugging Face and copy its link.
Decides what the quality presets mean. A wrong type gives noise or burnt pictures.
The fastest: one step, a picture in seconds. Simple scenes only, faces and details are rough.
1–4 steps at 512×512, about 3 GB of memory. Noticeably better than SDXS. Non-commercial licence.
4–8 steps, the best-looking of the fast models: illustration and semi-realism.
The classic base model: 20 steps and more, so several minutes per picture. Works with most LoRA files.
Tiny decoder for SD 1.x and 2.x models. Saves time and about 1 GB of memory at the last stage.
Light 4× upscaler, about four times faster than the full one. Best for drawings; smooths photos.
Full 4× upscaler for photos and realistic pictures. Slow: minutes even for a small picture.
Another picture is being made right now.
The picture was stopped before it was finished.
